name: Project: Jericho
source:
In a perfect future in which the world has been saved from the dire consequences of climate change, the rich members of the Uppercity from which you are from savor a life of luxury and tranquility. As the son of a famed engineer you developped an interest for your father's work, looking to improve it, but you'll soon discover that perfection had a price, that puts the very future of life at risk.

Take part in a dark dystopian future, heir to Tales of Unity's universe, meet and romance different races, Elf, Goblins, Half breeds in a realistic cyberpunk era.

Build strong relationships with a varried cast of characters and shape the world by your actions through meaningful choices leading to strong consequences.

Unveil the truth of your father's legacy and become the new player of a twisted game in which humanity's hope and future relies on your decisions.

[From [url=https://stronkboi.itch.io/project-jericho]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在一个完美的未来，世界已免于气候变化造成的严重后果。身为上城区的一员，你与其他富人过着奢华而安宁的生活。你是著名工程师之子，对父亲的工作产生兴趣，并希望加以改进；但你很快就会发现，所谓的完美自有代价，而这代价危及生命的未来。

置身于黑暗的反乌托邦未来，体验《Tales of Unity》世界观的延续。在写实风格的赛博朋克时代，结识不同种族的角色并与他们发展恋情，包括精灵、哥布林和混血种。

与性格各异的角色建立深厚关系，通过富有分量的选择影响世界，并承担相应的后果。

揭开父亲留下的真相，成为这场扭曲游戏中的新玩家；人类的希望与未来，取决于你的决定。

[摘自[url=https://stronkboi.itch.io/project-jericho]Itch.io[/url]]
